summary: classify-risk-test fails on main (its allow-list still names crates/smallclaims/src/**/migrat*, which now matches crates/smallclaims/src/store/principals/migration.rs) and CI never ran it. Drop the stale allowance and add classify-risk-test to scripts/ci-script-tests. The tracked-file glob check needs the whole repository, which the ci-script-tests lane's sparse tree does not hold, so it skips itself there and still runs on a full checkout; the other tests run in CI.
